description: Chief Secretary North Central Province - North Central Provincial Council Preventing Public Health Nuisances Statute No. 02 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a provincial statute ("North Central Province Council Preventing Public Health Nuisances Statute No. 02 of 2017") that establishes new regulations and legal frameworks for public health protection. It details specific offenses and regulatory requirements, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for new laws, acts, and regulatory matters.
